name: figdown
description: The FigDown project's own marketplace: one plugin, the FigDown figure skill.

plugins.name: figdown
plugins.description: A missing edge still looks fine. Text doesn't. FigDown keeps figures as text whose source states the meaning: participants, containment, field widths, table structure. The next reader can check it, not just look at it. Deterministic SVG, embedded in your Markdown — block diagrams, topologies, flowcharts, bit-level layouts, tables, timing waveforms.
